incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (17% over 10m). Paged olivia (oncall)
olivia (oncall): got the page, looking. any quick mitigation suggestions?
mike (eng): first check: autoscaler didn't spin new pods in region-us-west. seeing OOM on the inference workers.
nanaote: (typo - ignore)
nanaote: sorry ignore previous

anaote: ---
anaote: weird

ana (prodops): logs show repeated kernel OOMs in containerd, looks like memory blowout when sequence length spikes. Sample from worker0:
```
[2026-03-15T10:11:02Z] worker0 inference: kv-cache grow failed: alloc 1.2G, available 0.8G
[2026-03-15T10:11:03Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4521 (python) score 987
```

olivia (oncall): ok mitigating: 1) remove heavy model variant routing from us-west 2) scale dedicated-pool-embeddings +2 nodes 3) enable fallback-model routing to smaller-quantized variant (q4_0)

mike (eng): doing scale-up now: `rctl scale group dedicated-pool-embeddings --add 2 --region us-west`

mike (eng): also flipping routing rule:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing/policies/embeddings
{"priority_routes": ["q4_0-small","q8_standard"]}
```

incident-bot: action executed: scaled dedicated-pool-embeddings -> +2 nodes, routing updated, fallback enabled.

jess (support): customers reporting timeouts in last 30m, some got 502s. tagging impacted accounts list from support queue.
kai (customer-success): can we get a quick impact estimate to craft outreach? need # of customers + duration + SLO breaches.

mike (eng): preliminary: elevated errors from 10:10 to 10:28 UTC (18m). roughly 34 customers with active requests during window; top 5 customers bore 70% of errors.

olivia (oncall): sorry one more - I want a handoff to post-incident ops. aria, can you own the RCA and postmortem scheduling?

aria (eng-lead): I'll take lead. suggested timeline: collect logs + traces by EOD today, draft RCA by tomorrow noon, postmortem meeting Thurs 16:00 UTC.

anaote: testing bot again - ignore

aria (eng-lead): action items (quick):
- aria: own RCA + slides
- mike: collect worker heap dumps + fill memory profiling artifacts (due EOD)
- ana: check autoscaler policy + why it failed to add nodes (due EOD)
- olivia: write initial timeline + raw pager notes (due in 2h)
- jess/kai: draft customer outreach and list of impacted accounts (due 3h)
- support followups -> assign retention credits if needed (follow guidance)

olivia (oncall): timeline draft:
10:08 UTC - spike starts
10:10 UTC - incident-bot alerts
10:12 UTC - first page sent to oncall
10:15 UTC - mitigation: disable heavy variant routing in us-west
10:18 UTC - scale up +2 nodes initiated
10:23 UTC - routing fallback in place
10:28 UTC - errors returned to baseline

mike (eng): logs + heap dump locations:
- s3://redwood-ops/incident-2212345678/logs/worker0.log
- s3://redwood-ops/incident-2212345678/dumps/worker0_heap.tgz

jess (support): customer outreach draft (internal preview):
"We experienced elevated errors affecting embeddings requests between 10:10–10:28 UTC on March 15. Our engineers mitigated the issue by scaling capacity and routing traffic to a fallback model. We are investigating root cause and will share an RCA and timeline by March 16. If your application experienced errors, please reply and we will prioritize follow-up."

kai (customer-success): suggest adding: proactive token credit + optional 1:1 bridge for top impacted customers.

aria (eng-lead): agreed. we should offer credits for any customer who had > 1% error rate impact during window. jess, can you add the credit wording?

jess (support): added: "We will apply a service credit proportional to the impact — our team will follow up with specifics."

anaote: ignore stray bot messages again

aria (eng-lead): scheduling: postmortem Thurs 16:00 UTC, invite list: eng-runtime, prodops, support, customer-success. I'll create calendar invite after I have logs.

olivia (oncall): quick operational note for postmortem: please include metrics: token per-second distribution, seq-len distribution, KV cache growth, memory RSS over time. also include autoscaler policy YAML snapshot.

mike (eng): grabbing the autoscaler YAML now: `kubectl get configmap autoscaler-policy -o yaml > autoscaler-policy-2212345678.yaml`

aria (eng-lead): RCA share plan for customers:
- Publish status page entry with summary and timeline (short) — immediate update: "Resolved — investigating root cause"
- Email RCA + link to postmortem slide deck once ready (within 24h)
- Offer 1:1 calls for top affected accounts + apply credits as discussed

jess (support): I'll post the status page update draft to #statuspage-drafts for review.

olivia (oncall): quick note: mitigation left in place (fallback routing) for 2h to ensure stability, then we'll gradually revert. monitor errors and latency.

sre-bot: monitoring rule auto: error_rate_embeddings_us-west > 5% for 5m -> alerting to incidents. (no action)

aria (eng-lead): ok team — great response. next steps: collect artifacts, assemble RCA draft, reconvene for pre-brief Wed 12:00 UTC, full postmortem Thurs 16:00 UTC. jess/kai to own customer communications after we sign off the RCA.

kai (customer-success): I'll prepare top-customers list + propose times for 1:1s in the invite. thanks everyone. :heart:

olivia (oncall): closing pager for now — will remain reachable for handoff. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident 2212345678 marked resolved at 10:28 UTC (duration 18m).
